title: Klaviyo Review (2026)
intro: Klaviyo is evaluated here as email marketing software — Klaviyo is an ecommerce-focused email and SMS marketing platform with catalog-aware flows, segmentation, and revenue attribution — commonly used by Shopify and other online retailers. Pricing is primarily based on active profiles (and messaging credits for SMS); a free plan and paid Email / Email + SMS ladders are published with dynamic bands. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Klaviyo when ecommerce email + SMS with Shopify-native flows and revenue attribution are the primary jobs.
verdict: Choose Klaviyo when ecommerce email + SMS with Shopify-native flows and revenue attribution are the primary jobs. Compare ActiveCampaign for B2B/services automation depth, Brevo for send-based value pricing, Mailchimp for brand-familiar freemium, and Omnisend (when onboarded) for ecommerce multichannel alternatives. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Strong for ecommerce marketers familiar with flows/segments; learning curve rises vs simple newsletter ESPs because of profile, catalog, and SMS surfaces.
First-party campaign and flow email builders with ecommerce templates are core — strong composition for retail senders, not primarily a design-agency ESP story.
Shopify-native and catalog-aware flows (welcome, abandoned cart, browse/post-purchase) are the category’s ecommerce automation benchmark among researched ESPs.
Behavioral, predictive, and ecommerce attribute segmentation are first-party strengths — deeper than typical SMB newsletter tools.
Revenue attribution and ecommerce performance reporting are central to the product story — among the strongest analytics postures in this EM set.
Authentication and deliverability guidance are present; not a specialist reputation-repair suite like InboxAlly.
Deep ecommerce platform connectors (Shopify and peers) plus marketing stack hooks — integrations are a primary buying reason for online brands.
Active-profile packaging scales with store growth; high-volume brands are a documented sweet spot, with cost governance as the trade-off.
Free rung exists, but paid Email from ~$20/mo and profile-based scaling make Klaviyo premium at growth — score reflects accessibility/transparency of cost at scale, not affiliate terms.
AI content and recommendations are marketed across campaigns/flows; score reflects documented AI assistance rather than a hands-on lab audit.

faq.question: Is Klaviyo a full email marketing ESP?
faq.answer: Yes. Klaviyo is evaluated as email marketing / ESP software for campaigns, lists, and related automation — not as a full sales CRM of record.

faq.question: How is Klaviyo priced?
faq.answer: Free: up to 250 active profiles / 500 emails/mo. Paid Email from ~$20/mo at 251–500 profiles; Email + SMS from ~$35/mo at entry (research floors 2026-08-17). Scales by active profiles — confirm live pricing slider.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Klaviyo?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
